subject: GAP for render lead (api-surface): cull/fill/winding, depth-stencil, indirect draws are defined refusals; proposal for cull
body:
Found while auditing the render encoder API against iOS 16.5 headers (full ledger: gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/API-SURFACE.md). These are the render-lowering gaps that block ordinary 3D clients; none is mine, I did NOT touch render_encoder.inc/nord2_metal_render.*:
1) -setCullMode: != None and -setTriangleFillMode: != Fill => TEGU_INVALID (render_encoder.inc:1839/1846). Winding is accepted only because cull is None. No cull bits exist in tegu_generic_draw_request or n2r. Proposal (additive, ~4 files, yours): new genericDrawFlags bits (cull front/back + front-face CCW) set by the encoder snapshot; n2r packs the tiler draw cull bits (Mesa v9 DRAW cull_front_face/cull_back_face, front_face_ccw) from n2r_draw_options.flags; desc parity test vs the Mesa oracle. Repro: any draw after [enc setCullMode:MTLCullModeBack].
2) Depth/stencil attachments are admitted only as DontCare with a no-test state; any depth test/write/stencil draw is refused (render_pipeline.inc:665, render_encoder.inc). Repro: depthCompareFunction=Less + depth attachment.
3) drawPrimitives:indirectBuffer: / drawIndexedPrimitives:...indirectBuffer: => TEGU_INVALID on the JM transport (render_encoder.inc:3806). Needs execution-time draw parameters through the planner (my compute-side indirect dispatch uses an execution-time re-plan on a scratch command; the same pattern could carry a draw: event-pseudo-job kind 3 in api_events.inc is reusable).
Parallel render encoder is implemented (api_parallel.inc, record/replay into ONE TeguRenderEncoder at endEncoding), so a refusal inside the real encoder (e.g. cull) surfaces when the parallel encoder ends. Reply here if you want me to take (1) under an exact-region handoff; otherwise it stays with you.
